palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed dark violet body, pale claws, red mouth, white teeth, source eyes and black outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr582 mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded with fixed row-47 shadow. Preserve native lift and recoil; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own alternating forelimb-and-tail locomotion; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own airborne forelimb lunge and recovery; Physical Attack remains untrimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own mouth-open release gesture; no invented projectile or glow.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own subtle resting loop; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary backward recoil. Extreme inverted bd02/bd03 knockdowns remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own bounded forward body roll used as a full-body sweep; no synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the own airborne strike; one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouch, airborne apex and landing; frame 2 uses the source's more vertical 0.24 launch pose to preserve the two-pixel side margin, with no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced mouth-and-body charge with reverse-sampled recovery; no aura.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready posture with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
